q25_pairwise_common_measures.scope: Common tangent tensors embedded with zero normal stress and zero transverse shear define both peak invariants. This is distinct from each method's raw full3D peak. Identical angular rays sample every unioned tetrahedron boundary on both sides, outer/inner boundaries and depth Gauss nodes; surface/depth sampling convergence remains required. Positions are on the common reference rest columns. Normal and transverse shear components are integrated separately with the field metric weights; Shell lacks these independent 3D components and receives no transverse error rank.

scope: Prescribed C2 load only,0.1N per pole and fixed2mm radius. Native two-source reconstruction uses the original coarse solid mesh; Shell is the admitted250um velocity-cleared static replay. Native first differences measure source-profile reconstruction relative to the independent same-mesh load; Shell first differences combine thin-shell formulation/kinematics and load transfer. Second differences measure their separate solid controls' discretization/geometry differences. Signed tensor cross terms are measured, not inferred by scalar-error subtraction. Ranks are conditional on observed refinement/sampling envelopes bounding errors. This neither attributes physical-pad contact error by subtracting these norms nor qualifies sustained-friction dynamics.
